figurative_meaning_en: full of small holes or perforations
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই জ্যালজ্যালে কাপড় দিয়ে জল ছাঁকা যায় না।
তার যুক্তি জ্যালজ্যালে, কোথাও ধরে না।
example_sentences_in_english: This perforated cloth cannot be used to strain water.
His argument is full of holes; it doesn't hold anywhere.
note: Onomatopoeic term mimicking the sound or appearance of small holes, commonly used in Bengali for porous materials.
